Coverage: Five Australian NEM regions for the 2024 modelling year under three renewable-availability scenarios. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Storage trade-offs depend on the 2024 input year and the chosen renewable-availability and cost scenarios. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance.
